sections.title: Overview
descriptions: This page brings together available records related to Gregory Hazard’s encounter with the American Fork Police Department.

In his May 13, 2025 complaint-findings letter, Chief Cameron Paul concluded that Zachary Goodale violated department policy and state law, including unlawful parking in an accessible parking space. Paul also stated that Goodale should not have issued Hazard a trespass order, rescinded that order, and apologized on behalf of the department and city. The letters are included in Hazard’s June 9, 2026 City Council handout and are presented in the Department Response tab.

sections.title: Department Response
descriptions: Hazard’s June 9, 2026 City Council handout includes letters from Chief Cameron Paul documenting the department’s findings and response to his complaint. The handout was provided by Hazard; the chief’s letters within it are department-authored records.

In the May 13, 2025 complaint-findings letter (COM-2025-009), Paul concluded that Goodale’s conduct violated department policy and state law, including unlawful parking in an accessible parking space. He rejected Goodale’s claim that he was allowed to park there and stated that Goodale should not have issued Hazard a trespass order and did not have authority to do so.

Paul rescinded the trespass order and apologized on behalf of the department and city. The letter states that Goodale had resigned in January 2025, so Paul could not impose discipline, but would retain the complaint and findings in department records. A separate letter concerning incident 24AF03376 also confirms that the trespass order was rescinded.
